name: pos-app-diagrams
description: Flowchart diagram generation for POS App Flutter application

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('diagrams')) { fs.rmSync('diagrams', {recursive: true}); } fs.mkdirSync('diagrams', {recursive: true});"
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run generate
scripts.docs: npm run generate && npm run serve

author: POS App Team
